channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 23 November
item.description: The blockchain component received a fix for missing build stubs and a compose load problem. A test adjustment was made in the cognitive system to incorporate a compiler fix. Repositories: SuperGenius, GeniusCognitiveSystem, rlp_enodes, openapi-client-scaffold.

item.title: GNUS digest — Sunday 22 November
item.description: The wallet application fixed a startup issue, improved rename handling, added tests, and updated its configuration. The blockchain component repaired record cleanup, adjusted funding rollback, and performed several upgrades and refactoring. Repositories: GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 21 November
item.description: New support was added to recover validated certificates and handle pruned data in the blockchain system, along with fixes and extensive testing. Additional upgrades and documentation updates were made to the network component. Repositories: SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 20 November
item.description: The blockchain component introduced a downgrade mechanism for interlock gates and related fixes, and addressed research questions. The cognitive system received a test change, and the SDK tools fixed a review-related issue. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GeniusCognitiveSystem, openapi-client-scaffold, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusSDK.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 19 November
item.description: Research phases and upgrades were added to the blockchain and core components, with accompanying fixes and tests. Documentation was clarified and updated to reflect recent changes. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, gitbook, documentation, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, openapi-client-scaffold.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 18 November
item.description: The blockchain component revised plans based on feedback and added new documentation. SDK tools improved pagination handling and added tests. New evidence matrix features were added to the core component. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius.
